COOKSINGLEPACKAGE_BEHAVIOR: In UE4.26, -cooksinglepackage does not restrict cooking to a single package. It still performs full dependency discovery and cooks all transitive dependencies of the specified map. The flag primarily affects the output packaging (single .pak vs multiple) and iterative cooking behavior, not the dependency graph traversal.
RECOMMENDATION: If true single-package cooking is required, use -cookonlymap or manually specify the exact package list. For production Ingolstadt cooking, the full dependency expansion is correct and expected behavior.
